body:
Implement the spec in .adlc/specs/cli.md. Build cli/index.ts (commands: icons sets|search|show, presets, schema, render), cli/render.ts (pure spec->SVG), cli/icons.ts (load from @iconify/json, fuse.js search), cli/spec.ts (types, defaults, validation, JSON schema), cli/bin.mjs (spawns tsx cli/index.ts). Add a `logo` script and a `just-logo` bin to package.json; add @resvg/resvg-js as a dependency, imported lazily. Reuse getCleanIconBody from src/lib/utils.ts and AVAILABLE_ICON_SETS/PRESETS from src/lib/constants.ts; do not edit src/**. Write vitest tests under cli/ (unit tests for the gradient parser, render function and schema; integration tests that spawn the CLI with `tsx cli/index.ts`). Document a CLI section in README.md with every command and one agent-oriented example (search, write a JSON spec, render).

Acceptance criteria and the command that verifies each:
- AC1 search: `pnpm logo icons search rocket --json` exits 0; first results include {set:"lucide", name:"rocket"}. Test: cli/cli.test.ts.
- AC2 unknown icon: `pnpm logo render --icon lucide:no-such-icon --out -` exits 1, stderr has `error: icon not found` and a `help:` line. Test: cli/cli.test.ts.
- AC3 SVG parity: `pnpm logo render --icon lucide:rocket --preset "Ocean Breeze" --out -` prints one 512x512 <svg> with a <linearGradient> (stops #667eea, #764ba2), a background <rect> with rx = default radius, and a nested <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" color="#ffffff">. Tests: cli/render.test.ts (unit + snapshot).
- AC4 gradient parser: linear-gradient(135deg, #a 0%, #b 100%) -> x1/y1/x2/y2 for 135deg; three stops -> three <stop>s; non-gradient string passes through. Test: cli/render.test.ts.
- AC5 config + override: spec.json {icon:"tabler:heart", size:200} with `--size 300` renders tabler heart at 300. Test: cli/cli.test.ts.
- AC6 PNG: `pnpm logo render --icon lucide:rocket --out /tmp/logo.png` writes PNG signature, IHDR 512x512; `--png-size 1024` -> 1024x1024. Test: cli/cli.test.ts.
- AC7 JSON contract: every command with --json prints exactly one JSON value on stdout, on success and on error. Test: cli/cli.test.ts.
- AC8 schema: `pnpm logo schema` prints a JSON schema and the default spec validates against it. Test: cli/spec.test.ts.
- AC9 editor untouched: `pnpm build` succeeds and `pnpm test` passes; src/** unchanged (rails-guard).
- AC10 docs: README has a CLI section covering all commands plus the agent example.

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 operational error, 2 usage error. Errors: stderr `error: <what>` then `help: <runnable fix>`; with --json the same object goes to stdout.
title: Add a headless just-logo CLI so agents can search icons and render logos without a browser
